scope.module_policy: Every tracked AgrawalCore module is classified. A candidate entry means only that human Mathlib review may be worthwhile; it is not a claim of novelty or merge readiness.

searches.detail: Exact identifiers and nearby semantic APIs were searched in the pinned checkout.
The canary returned Mathlib/Data/PNat/Prime.lean, so the negative exact-name searches were not produced by a dead search surface.
The candidate identifiers were searched with extension:lean. Exact-name absence is only a deduplication signal; semantic duplication must still be judged by a Mathlib maintainer.
